description: Header file defining the DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher class responsible for DHCP lookup and PAC file fetching on Windows, including related classes, methods, and state management.

classes.name: DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher
classes.description: Manages DHCP lookup and PAC file fetching for a network adapter, including state management and callback handling.

classes.name: DhcpQuery
classes.description: Encapsulates DHCP query work on a worker thread, retrieving the PAC URL from DHCP.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.description: Starts the process of DHCP lookup and PAC file fetch for a specified network adapter.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing DHCP or PAC fetch operations.

methods.name: DidFinish
methods.description: Checks if the fetch process has completed successfully.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Returns the network error code indicating fetch result.

methods.name: GetPacScript
methods.description: Returns the fetched PAC script content.

methods.name: GetPacURL
methods.description: Returns the PAC URL retrieved from DHCP.

methods.name: GetPacURLFromDhcp
methods.description: Synchronously retrieves the PAC URL configured in DHCP for a given adapter.

methods.name: SanitizeDhcpApiString
methods.description: Sanitizes a string returned via the DHCP API.
